description: This file defines utilities for managing and interacting with launchctl, including running commands, parsing launch agent plist files, and extracting specific configuration details.

classes.name: Launchctl.Result
classes.description: Holds the result of executing a launchctl command, including status and output.

classes.name: LaunchAgentPlistSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of properties extracted from a launch agent plist file.

methods.name: Launchctl.run
methods.description: Executes a launchctl command asynchronously with specified arguments and returns the result.

methods.name: LaunchAgentPlist.snapshot
methods.description: Reads a plist file at a given URL and parses it into a LaunchAgentPlistSnapshot, extracting various configuration parameters.

methods.name: Self.extractFlagInt
methods.description: Helper to extract an integer value from command-line arguments given a specific flag.

methods.name: Self.extractFlagString
methods.description: Helper to extract a string value from command-line arguments given a specific flag.
